title: Concept: Meta content security policy allows inline script
description: A meta tag whose policy grants unsafe-inline in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The policy is delivered in the document, so any injected markup that lands before the meta tag runs before the policy applies, and inline script stays allowed everywhere after it.
applicability: Deployments that render a meta tag whose policy grants unsafe-inline into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The policy is delivered in the document, so any injected markup that lands before the meta tag runs before the policy applies, and inline script stays allowed everywhere after it.
